decisions.reason: The naval vessel lighting system builds directly on the firm's established specialist-lighting, engineering and certification capabilities, and its continued presence through 2024 suggests management has enough market feedback and technical learning to keep improving it.

The spring-balanced desk lamp appears less connected to the firm's core application-specific project lighting and disappeared from the website after 2023, indicating limited strategic fit and weak enough early results to stop allocating resources to it.

A general interior lighting luminaire is highly aligned with the firm's core knowledge in building lighting and energy-efficient solutions, and its ongoing website presence indicates commercially usable learning and continuing relevance.

The pendant luminaire with microprismatic optics fits the firm's deep optical and workplace-lighting expertise, and its continued promotion into 2024 suggests the firm can absorb user feedback and refine it within its existing product architecture.

The marine searchlight matches the firm's competence in robust specialist lighting for demanding environments, and retaining it through 2024 implies sufficient technical and market understanding to justify continued support despite pruning related variants.
